latest_release.body:
Minor updates release.

## Pull requests grouped by target

### cpp target
* [[Cpp] Use target_include_dirs for cmake targets](https://github.com/antlr/antlr4/pull/4661) (target:cpp)
* [Update C++ documentation to state that C++17 is required](https://github.com/antlr/antlr4/pull/4588) (comp:doc, target:cpp)

### go target
* [fix go-target.md, remove duplicate 'get'](https://github.com/antlr/antlr4/pull/4292) (comp:doc, target:go)

### javascript target
* [fix(javascript): fix types not being recognized for NodeNext module resolution](https://github.com/antlr/antlr4/pull/4540) (target:javascript)
* [[Javascript] Fix broken package entrypoints](https://github.com/antlr/antlr4/pull/4411) (target:javascript, type:cleanup)

### python3 target
* [name 'state' conflict with Python3 runtime.](https://github.com/antlr/antlr4/pull/4312) (target:python3)
